quickref.name: Skate or Die
quickref.era: BBG launch map (May–June 2013). SkyVu's May 30, 2013 trailer description lists it in '3 New Maps: -Gold Digger -Skate or Die -Sky View' [Canon]. Not in BBR. No documented rework; game-wide 'New Map Lighting' in v3.0 (Nov 15, 2021) [Game text via wiki].
quickref.in_2026: Not named on the Steam page [Canon]. Track 7 'Skate Or Die' (1:29) on the official 2026 soundtrack [Canon]. Shown in the official shorts 'Dangerous Skate Parks' (May 7, 2025) and 'BBG Maps Ranked part 1' (16-map grid) [Observed]. In 2026 PC playtests per fan footage: Team Battle (7/29/26) and FFA (Playtest #3) [Observed metadata and frames; Inference that it ships].
quickref.setting: Open-air walled concrete skatepark under two crossing elevated highway decks on hammerhead piers, covered in Battle Bears graffiti; the wiki says 'a skating park below two highways' [Fan-wiki; Observed]. A large, wide, open map with no jump pads [Fan-wiki].
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Clear daylight with a late-afternoon feel [Inference]: cornflower-blue sky #5776B1 fading to peach haze #EADFDC; warm cream sunlit concrete #E4C9B1; taupe-grey slabs #806F62–#9C8879; charcoal overpass #302B2D; honey plywood ramps (#6C4C2D shade, #FD994B sun); rust rails #59311E; black steel ledges #181618; pale aqua painted 'water' bowls #B5DADD; graffiti accents: meadow green #419A02, Huggable pink #EA7197, rainbow orange #E97649, ABBi lens blue #246280. Long, hard shadows from the decks [Observed].
quickref.landmarks: 1) Overpass decks on hammerhead piers. 2) Dry bowls painted as water with a leaping painted goldfish. 3) Giant grey camera with a glowing blue lens beside the 'ABBi' tag (ABBi's eye [Inference]). 4) Pink bone-limbed Huggable mural beside the pier tagged 'Oops, Killed ya!' (the map icon). 5) 'BATTLE BEARS' TV-series mural [Fan-wiki caption]. 6) 'BATTLE BEARS.' billboard on a pole above the wall; also a meadow mural with pink Huggables and a rainbow-to-skull graffito [Observed].
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: No hazards documented or seen; no jump pads; two each of Bearscream Sandwich, Imperial Basket Grande, Health Pack and Shield [Fan-wiki]. Easter eggs: the BB TV series mural (cancelled W!LDBRAIN show); Oliver's kill line 'Oops, killed ya!' as graffiti; 'ABBi' tag and camera; a 'B-1000' heart tag; Huggables everywhere; a possible Tillman panda [Observed/Inference].

corrections.correction: Name the maps. 43.0–45.5 s is Aztec Attack. ≈45.5–47.5 s is Skate or Die (overhead of the painted-water bowl, wooden kicker, black box at an overpass pier and the giant ABBi camera); the yellow tracer dots and the golden blasts at ≈46.0 s (kicker base) and ≈47.0–47.2 s (large yellow half-dome at the pool edge) are on Skate or Die. From ≈47.5 s a construction-site map of wooden planks and teal tarps follows (probably Sky View, Inference); Gold Digger is ≈51.9–54 s.

corrections.current_text: - [WIKI] Battle Bears TV: a cartoon planned with WildBrain Entertainment for 2014, featuring Astoria, Oliver, Riggs, Graham, Wil and Tillman, set after BB Zero. It was "presumably cancelled." It "replaced the Battle Bears Movie."
corrections.correction: Add that the series left a trace in BBG: a Skate or Die mural reproduces the 2012 'THE TELEVISION SERIES / COMING SOON!' key-art lettering (distressed black 'BATTLE BEARS' over a teal glow) with a brown, a yellow and a goggled bear [Observed]; the wiki captions it 'Battle Bears TV show in the map' [Fan-wiki].
